case_study_rishikesh.finding: Ground truth is 90 (world-famous river rafting & bungee capital), but the model predicted 27.7. The Wikimedia photo manifest shows Laxman Jhula bridge, Triveni Ghat prayer ceremonies, and riverside yoga ashrams rather than active white-water rafting, causing CLIP vision embeddings to encode serene architectural/cultural aesthetics rather than extreme sports.
